definitions.explanation: A cultivated area planted with fruit trees. In Japan, often open for fruit picking activities.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{果樹園|かじゅえん}でりんご{狩|が}りをした。
examples.english: I went apple picking at an orchard on the weekend.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{果樹園|かじゅえん}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This region is famous for its orchards.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{果樹園|かじゅえん}では{桃|もも}と{梨|なし}を{栽培|さいばい}している。
examples.english: My grandfather's orchard grows peaches and pears.

notes:
COMPOSITION:
・{果樹|かじゅ} (fruit tree) + {園|えん} (garden/farm)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{果樹園|かじゅえん}で{働|はたら}く (to work at an orchard)
・{果樹園|かじゅえん}を{経営|けいえい}する (to run an orchard)
・{観光|かんこう}{果樹園|かじゅえん} (tourist orchard - for fruit picking)

FRUIT PICKING ACTIVITIES:
Many Japanese {果樹園|かじゅえん} offer fruit picking experiences ({果物狩|くだものが}り):
・りんご{狩|が}り (apple picking)
・{桃|もも}{狩|が}り (peach picking)
・{梨|なし}{狩|が}り (pear picking)
・ぶどう{狩|が}り (grape picking)
・いちご{狩|が}り (strawberry picking)

RELATED TERMS:
・{果樹|かじゅ}: fruit tree
・{農園|のうえん}: farm, plantation
・{畑|はたけ}: field, farm plot
・{果実|かじつ}: fruit
